note: Projections apply each county's own counted vote share to that county's own outstanding ballots. Outstanding counts only ballots already cast and not yet counted - election-day turnout that has not happened is not in it, so it is a floor.

senate.outstanding_basis: measured early and mail not yet counted, plus any outstanding mail, provisional and UOCAVA the state publishes, plus election-day ballots from precincts not yet reporting, scaled from what the reporting precincts produced. Each part is spent at the vote share of its OWN mode.
